definitions.gloss: stupid-looking face; idiotic expression; dopey face
definitions.explanation: A face or facial expression that looks foolish, absent-minded, or vacant. Used as an insult or in humorous self-deprecation.

examples.japanese: そんな{間抜|まぬ}け{面|づら}するな。
{鏡|かがみ}に{映|うつ}った{自分|じぶん}の{間抜|まぬ}け{面|づら}に{笑|わら}ってしまった。
examples.english: I couldn't help laughing at my own stupid face reflected in the mirror.

examples.japanese: {口|くち}を{開|あ}けて{寝|ね}ている{間抜|まぬ}け{面|づら}を{写真|しゃしん}に{撮|と}られた。
examples.english: Someone took a photo of my dopey face sleeping with my mouth open.

notes:
Composed of {間抜|まぬ}け (fool, idiot) + {面|づら} (face — rough/informal word). A rude but commonly heard expression. The suffix {面|づら} is a coarser alternative to {顔|かお} and adds a derogatory or humorous tone.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {間抜|まぬ}け{面|づら}をする: to make a stupid face
- {間抜|まぬ}け{面|づら}を{晒|さら}す: to show one's stupid face (to the public)
- {間抜|まぬ}け{面|づら}で{歩|ある}く: to walk around looking like an idiot

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {間抜|まぬ}け: fool, idiot — the base word, describing someone who misses the timing or point
- とぼけた{顔|かお}: blank/feigned-ignorance face — similar look but implies deliberateness
- {能面|のうめん}のような{顔|かお}: Noh-mask-like face — expressionless rather than foolish
